# Which households were never appealed, and what distinguishes them?

```{python}
#| label: setup-skipped
import pandas as pd
from hh.io import read_parquet
from hh.viz import money, pct

t = read_parquet("processed", "appeal_households.parquet")
skip = t[~t["appealed"]].copy()
n_appealed = int(t["appealed"].sum())
```

::: {.callout-warning}
The tables on this page name households — local only.
:::

The universe is all `{python} f"{len(t):,}"` household rollups in the Neon pull.
Of these, `{python} f"{n_appealed:,}"` (`{python} pct(n_appealed / len(t))`)
got the appeal. This page profiles the rest.

## Engagement profile: appealed vs not

`eng_profile` counts only activity before the appeal mailed (events starting
on or before September 30, 2025); `none` means no registrations at all before
the appeal.

```{python
mix = pd.crosstab(t["eng_profile"], t["appealed"])
mix.columns = ["not appealed", "appealed"]
mix["not-appealed share"] = (mix["not appealed"] / mix["not appealed"].sum()).map(pct)
mix["appealed share"] = (mix["appealed"] / mix["appealed"].sum()).map(pct)
mix
```

## Donor status of the not-appealed

```{python}
rows = []
for label, mask in [
    ("prior donors (gave before the appeal)", skip["prior_donor"]),
    ("gave in FY25", skip["prior_fy_donor"]),
    ("gave to the FY26 appeal campaign anyway", skip["responded"]),
    ("deceased (any member)", skip["deceased_any"]),
    ("do-not-contact (any member)", skip["dnc_any"]),
    ("no mailing address on file", ~skip["has_mail"]),
]:
    part = skip[mask.fillna(False)]
    rows.append(
        {
            "group": label,
            "households": len(part),
            "share of not-appealed": pct(len(part) / len(skip)),
            "lifetime giving before appeal": money(part["prior_lifetime_amount"].sum()),
        }
    )
pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

## Prior donors who were not appealed

```{python}
donors_skipped = skip[skip["prior_donor"]].nlargest(25, "prior_lifetime_amount")
donors_skipped = donors_skipped[
    ["name", "prior_lifetime_amount", "prior_last_gift", "eng_profile", "has_mail", "dnc_any", "city"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "name": "household", "prior_lifetime_amount": "lifetime before appeal",
        "prior_last_gift": "last gift", "eng_profile": "engagement",
        "has_mail": "has address", "dnc_any": "DNC", "city": "town",
    }
).reset_index(drop=True)
donors_skipped["lifetime before appeal"] = donors_skipped["lifetime before appeal"].map(money)
donors_skipped
```

## Households that gave to the campaign without being appealed

```{python}
gave_unasked = skip[skip["responded"]].nlargest(10, "afd_amount")
gave_unasked = gave_unasked[["name", "afd_amount", "afd_company_gift", "city"]].rename(
    columns={"name": "household", "afd_amount": "campaign gifts in window",
             "afd_company_gift": "company gift", "city": "town"}
).reset_index(drop=True)
gave_unasked["campaign gifts in window"] = gave_unasked["campaign gifts in window"].map(money)
gave_unasked
```

## Where the not-appealed live

```{python}
dist = (
    skip.groupby("distance_band", observed=True)
    .agg(households=("id", "count"), prior_donor_households=("prior_donor", "sum"))
    .reset_index()
)
dist["prior-donor share"] = (dist["prior_donor_households"] / dist["households"]).map(pct)
dist
```
